name: AMM Motion + HoloFX
purpose: Original TryAMM motion graphics and holographic effects layer that can play Lottie-compatible assets while also defining TryAMM-native reusable motion primitives, templates and holographic effects.

lottieCompatibility.versionPolicy: Use the installed npm dependency and lock/test upgrades before production rollout.
lottieCompatibility.assetPolicy: Only use original, licensed, purchased or public-domain animation assets. Do not copy proprietary competitor assets.

tryammNativeLibrary.name: AMM Motion Graph
tryammNativeLibrary.concept: A lightweight declarative scene graph for reusable vector, text, particle, glow, parallax, depth, audio-cue and holographic animation presets.
